snippet.title: Whistle!: Dai 37-kai Tokyo-to Chuugakkou Sougou Taiiku Soccer Taikai | ~6:57:54
snippet.description:
ホイッスル!
Whistle!: Dai 37-kai Tokyo-to Chuugakkou Sougou Taiiku Soccer Taikai (GBA, run using RetroArch)

Leaderboards here: https://www.speedrun.com/Whistle_D37

EDIT: Got a much faster run here if you'd like to see: https://youtu.be/-v3ly-0JpEQ

I had reached the point where I figured I just wouldn't be able to beat the game, let alone beat each match on the first try. I'd never gotten past the match where Shige leaves the team prior to this attempt (even in casual playing). Once I figured out how to pass more properly, it all started working out. And toward the end, I realized I could refine my little diamond trap.

Basically, a lot of this run could be faster. I was really worried I wouldn't be able to win the matches period, so I continued to play them out even when I had the point advantage in order to give my team better stats (as they gain stats through action, as far as I'm aware). And who knows, maybe I wouldn't have been able to win if I hadn't done that and gotten them those stats, but it's certainly possible.

It's a relief to finally finish the game (let alone a run), and I'm glad I was able to push through the hopelessness of my earlier attempts. I might revisit it (in the near future or otherwise) to improve my time, but we'll see; even if I am able to go faster, it's a long run, so it'd be a commitment.

Lastly, I'd like to dedicate this speedrun to Flicka, one of my silly, wonderful cats, who passed away just a few hours before I started this run (October 7th, 2024). Rest in peace, Flicka. I love you.
